property_summary: For any call to fallback sending exactly 10 ether from an EOA at a time strictly after the previous stored pastBlockTime, the reference contract always sets pastBlockTime to a value > block.timestamp (i.e., block.timestamp+1) so after the call pastBlockTime != block.timestamp, whereas the mutant that assigns pastBlockTime = block.timestamp can make pastBlockTime == block.timestamp for some inputs, violating this rule.
change_summary: Change the update to pastBlockTime to set it to block.timestamp (remove +1), so the stored time after fallback differs by one second.
